question: For delivered order items where seller and customer are in different states, what is the median delivery time in fractional days?
sql:
WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        o.order_delivered_customer_date,
        c.customer_state,
        s.seller_state
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND c.customer_state IS NOT NULL
      AND s.seller_state IS NOT NULL
      AND c.customer_state <> s.seller_state
)
SELECT 
    median((epoch(order_delivered_customer_date) - epoch(order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0) AS median_delivery_days
FROM delivered
plan:
• Identify delivered order items by joining order_items to orders where order_status = 'delivered'.
• Join orders to customers on customer_id to get customer_state, and join order_items to sellers on seller_id to get seller_state.
• Filter rows where seller_state <> customer_state.
• Compute delivery time as the difference in days (including fractional part) between order_delivered_customer_date and order_purchase_timestamp.
• Calculate the median of these delivery times using a percentile function.
• Return a single numeric value representing the median delivery time in days.
